Each ask is something a cold session actually had to answer; expected = the ledger ids it must land on; terms = words the ask contains that must appear in the rule's title/aliases/statement so the family strip can find it. The batch-17 misses are the first cases. Checked by scripts/restructure/one-hop-check.ts; the cold-session probe (verdict-verifier, different model) uses the same file.
